turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how's everything with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm well, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to stop buying coffee every morning and make it at home instead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan, you'll save a lot. Do you want something simple like a French press, or are you ready to invest in an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the plumber say when he's coming?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sometime between ten and twelve.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why are you holding my controller like that?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I need a favour. There's this level with the moving platforms, I've died about fifty times.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You want me to beat it for you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just this one. I'll do the rest myself, promise.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is that cheating?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's teamwork.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. But you're making tea.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Done. Milk, no sugar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, back to you, Moshi, I'm listening now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Decided between the French press and the espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. My coworker puts butter in his coffee and says it's the secret to productivity. Is that a thing?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's a trend, often called butter coffee. People blend coffee with butter and sometimes coconut oil.
